business_problem: Embat needed to automate complex reconciliation and treasury workflows for finance teams, reduce manual intervention and accounting errors, and keep adding advanced automation capabilities without building a custom training dataset for each customer scenario.
solution_summary: Embat built its treasury-automation platform on Google Cloud and used Vertex AI generative AI to improve the most complex reconciliation and accounting tasks. The fintech runs its hosting, microservices architecture, databases, analytics, and ERP integrations on Google Cloud, then uses Vertex AI to break complex tasks into simpler subtasks and enrich transaction data before it reaches the reconciliation engine. That enrichment layer extracts more useful context from receipts and payments, reduces unnecessary data, and generates more accurate settlement suggestions for customers without requiring a bespoke training corpus. The resulting platform automates cases that previously required human intervention and feeds its outputs into an automatic accounting workflow that produces daily receipt and payment logs. Embat is extending the same foundation with Gemini for Google Workspace and additional automation experiments as it expands the product.

solution_components.name: Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Runs the generative AI workflows that enrich reconciliation data, break complex tasks into subtasks, and improve automatic settlement suggestions.

solution_components.name: Gemini for Google Workspace
solution_components.role: Extends Embat's Google Cloud-based automation foundation into employee productivity and future finance workflows.

data_flow: Payment and receipt data flows through Embat's Google Cloud microservices and external ERP integrations into Vertex AI, which enriches and classifies the records for automatic reconciliation. The enriched outputs feed Embat's settlement proposal engine and daily accounting logs, which finance teams review and act on.
business_outcome: Embat reduced manual finance work, eliminated residual automated-suggestion errors, and turned Google Cloud-based generative AI into a competitive differentiator for treasury automation in the Spanish fintech market.
